pages.title: Defense and response
pages.text: Fire contact, burning, lava and falling do not damage it. Direct damage attributed to thrown potions and area-effect clouds is rejected too. Plan direct attacks and an escape route instead of a lava trap.

pages.title: Ordinary combat
pages.text: This profile does not use hosted preparation. Fight it normally rather than looking for Start. Defeating this enemy contributes to world-tier progression.

pages.title: Loot and use
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Warped Mushroom Cap Part. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.
